cut_order_if_behind: M3c per-layer detail down to at-band only
M2 down to the outcomes actually used in a verdict

failure_modes.empty_results_block: reported as EMPTY in the summary, never silently omitted
failure_modes.file_absent: record ABSENT with the glob that was run; never substitute a neighbour
failure_modes.needs_activations_never_saved: name the quantity and the lane that must re-harvest it
failure_modes.npz_will_not_load: record the exception verbatim; mark NEEDS_REHARVEST

run_invariant.enforcement: Every row of every table carries a READOUT_CLASS field. A table missing the column is rejected by the artifact's own self-check, and no summary sentence may name a BASELINE_ONLY row as the answer.
run_invariant.framing: Mechanistic-interpretability study of WHERE SAFETY LIVES -- recognition of harm versus execution of a refusal. No attack-success rate is an outcome in any table; behavioural columns appear only as the ground truth an internal readout is validated against.
run_invariant.statement: The commissioned comparison and any metric built from it must read ACTIVATIONS or WEIGHTS of a SINGLE model. Logit-only and text-only readouts are baselines, never the result.

scope: Zero-GPU, zero-API, zero-download re-adjudication of iteration 1's three lanes, computed only from files already on disk. Lane workspaces are read-only; nothing is written to them.
standardisation: Across checkpoints, each checkpoint's OWN null-SD is the unit; the raw-scale table is printed alongside. The isotropic random-direction unit is a UNIT and not a TEST: well calibrated for CONTRASTS where the shared anisotropic component cancels, poorly calibrated for ABSOLUTE readouts. The decisive control is always the shuffled-label band.
title: Re-checking the numbers we already have
